description: تقرير قائمة المراجعة — جميع العناصر بانتظار الاعتماد البشري
name: Data Review Queue Report
query: SELECT drq.name AS review_id, drq.item_type AS type, drq.entity_name AS entity, drq.source_activity AS activity, drq.proposed_value AS proposed, drq.confidence AS confidence, drq.status AS status, drq.created_on AS created, drq.decided_by AS decided_by, drq.decided_on AS decided_on, drq.notes AS notes FROM `tabData Review Queue` drq ORDER BY drq.created_on DESC LIMIT 500
